# ONNX Runtime Web browser entry

`ort.wasm.min.mjs` is the browser WASM entry from `onnxruntime-web@1.24.3` (MIT).
It is vendored so the JavaScript API always matches the 1.24.3 WASM files served from `public/models/paddleocr/onnxruntime-web/`, regardless of dependency hoisting during installation.
